# BlogPage: its buttons, fields and dropdowns

What the crawl saw on pages of this type that a visitor can use (links are in
ai/GLOSSARY.md), read only: nothing was clicked, typed or sent. Each locator matched exactly one element
on the page it was read from. Those it trusts are already in `BlogElements`, each with the method
that uses it; a fragile one (its locator counts positions) is not, and has a line to paste into the
**elements** YOURS block once checked against a saved page (ai/recipes/add-an-element.md). Controls on most pages (a footer form) are in
controls/Everywhere.md. Not listed: anything that appears only after a click, behind a login, or
after a form is sent; ask for a saved page of that.

## Header

- **`English (US)`**: `button`. Seen on 3 of 3 crawled pages. In `BlogElements` as `ENGLISH_US_BUTTON`: `click().englishUs()`.
- **`Try It Free`**: `button`. Seen on 3 of 3 crawled pages. In `BlogElements` as `TRY_IT_FREE_BUTTON`: `click().tryItFree()`.

## In the page

- **`Subscribe to Blog`**: `button`. Seen on 3 of 3 crawled pages. In `BlogElements` as `SUBSCRIBE_TO_BLOG_BUTTON`: `click().subscribeToBlog()`.

## `Get the latest cybersecurity news and updates sent straight` form (in the page)

- **`Email*` / `Email Address` / `email`**: `email field`. Seen on 2 of 3 crawled pages (e.g. /blog/2024/02/23/why-organizations-need-automated-password-rotation/). In `BlogElements` as `EMAIL_INPUT`: `enter().email(...)`.
- **`Sign Up`**: `button`. Seen on 2 of 3 crawled pages (e.g. /blog/2024/02/23/why-organizations-need-automated-password-rotation/). In `BlogElements` as `SIGN_UP_BUTTON`: `click().signUp()`.
